<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/types`, touching **30** documentable anchor(s).

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/automation/connectors/credential-refs (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx`  _(via sys_metadata_activation (literal, a string literal in SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/actions/_activation (route, a path literal in WHERE_PLATFORM_ACTION))_
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via sys_metadata_activation (literal, a string literal in SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/automation/connectors/credential-refs (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via sys_metadata_activation (literal, a string literal in SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS))_
- `content/docs/permissions/sharing-rules.mdx`  _(via sys_metadata_activation (literal, a string literal in SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS))_
- `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`  _(via group_apps (literal, a string literal in group))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/automation/connectors/credential-refs (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-4.mdx`  _(via sys_metadata_activation (literal, a string literal in SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `ObjectQL (symbol, 81 pages)`
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **177** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4771d66a2b90ae927c7c044c022f0ac5f4534ef4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5cf3fb3c81f1242fa15e2474ed37f7625b792263` — the merge of head `d6b8707b0aa7841d23b6c837a557c2a63c387710` into base `4771d66a2b90ae927c7c044c022f0ac5f4534ef4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5cf3fb3c81f1242fa15e2474ed37f7625b792263 && git checkout 5cf3fb3c81f1242fa15e2474ed37f7625b792263
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4771d66a2b90ae927c7c044c022f0ac5f4534ef4 d6b8707b0aa7841d23b6c837a557c2a63c387710 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4771d66a2b90ae927c7c044c022f0ac5f4534ef4 && git merge --no-ff d6b8707b0aa7841d23b6c837a557c2a63c387710

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4771d66a2b90ae927c7c044c022f0ac5f4534ef4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4771d66a2b90ae927c7c044c022f0ac5f4534ef4` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: 86e18a95b4c14aaf23b37da2040b1a7c9cdff72c

L1 read of #34799 for #34724 (2026-11-17T11:02Z). Merge-base f6f5b50a, 1 commit, no merges, 67 files, +1355/−1910. It merges cleanly with current `origin/main` 6091b645.

- **Tier H twice.** `check-governed-merges --pr 34799` reports two things:
  - `docs/adr/0146-*.md`, which is not an add-only note, since it adds lines under the Decision heading;
  - 3265 changed lines, over the 3000-line human-merge line.
- **CI was still running at this read.** Build Core, Build UI Deps, Test Core 1–8, Live E2E UI and the type checks were in progress. Build Docs, Dogfood Regression Gate, Lint · repo & tooling gates and Type Check · source gates were green.

**What holds:**
- **Shape.** `Fixes #34724`. Item 5 is deferred inside this PR, per seat amendment 6943362097; see S1.
- **Changeset.** It names every published package whose src moved: `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/core`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/service-automation`. `@objectstack/runtime` moves only a test. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so its entry is harmless. The ADR-0087 disposition is stated and reasoned.
- **Ruling 6944409840 is applied as ruled.** Rows that switch off a platform action stay in force. There is no boot step and no door change. The changeset gives the query, including the `hasMore: true` caveat, and the recovery call.
  - For a platform action, the `ACTION_DISABLED` sentence names the activation door. `describeDisabledAction` judges this from the package the ledger row names, against the registry's installed manifest (scope `system`/`cloud`).
  - An ablation turns it red.
  - The live dogfood pin on plugin-auth's `ban_user` reads the door sentence.
  - The local scope list in `engine-actions.ts` is reasoned: `./core` must not import metadata-protocol.
- **The ADR-0146 D4 amendment matches the card and the ruling.**
  - It supersedes the "out of this epic" bullet.
  - The doors and gate are unchanged.
  - Platform actions get no switch anywhere.
  - The retirement happens in the same change, so no window is left without a switch.
  - It reaffirms ⛔ no action clone, which follows D6/D9.
- **Items 1–3 in code.** `useActionLedger` offers a switch only when `fetchPackages()` lists the package with `kernel !== true`. A manifest-scoped kernel package (unlisted), a flat `system|cloud` row (`kernel: true`) and an unreadable list all draw nothing. `~all`/`~org` never list. A writable package reads nothing. The write body is exactly `{ enabled }`, and refusals come back verbatim. The walled gate is the flow door's own `useFlowLedgerWalledReadOnly`, because `refuseUngrantedActivationWrite` serves both doors.
- **Item 4.** The nav entry, page, registration, export and translations are removed, and the key is tombstoned. Both redirects were read live.
- **Item 6.** The ADR, the nav comment and both named pins are updated.
- **New strings.** There are four studio-namespace keys, in en and zh, which is the namespace's full set of packs. The zh wording follows the flow switch's 「本部署」. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/**` is byte-identical to main, so the eager `i18n-locale-en` budget is unaffected (61,603 B reported).
- **Live readings** (body table, showcase dev boot):
  - the flip on an object action and on an object-less action (`global`), with the POST bodies, the ledger rows and the state after a reload;
  - no switch on plugin-auth's Invite User, with a control;
  - no Setup entry;
  - both redirects.

## Must-fix

**M1. Two acceptance items have no live reading.** These are the same standard as #34656, #34665, #34677, #34697 and #34713. Please post readings on this head, with shots under `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/34724-live/`:
1. **Acceptance 1, second half.** The card reads 「记录页上该按钮按现有规则不再可用」. The body reads the ledger row and the switch, but not the record page. With Mark Done switched off in Studio, open a `showcase_task` record page. Read what the button does now (hidden or disabled, per the existing `disabledActions` rule). Read what a direct `POST` of it answers: 409 `ACTION_DISABLED` with the new Studio sentence. Then switch it back on and read the button again.
2. **Acceptance 4.** The card reads 「无权翻转的用户看到的是禁用态和服务端的原话，不是一个点了就 403 的开关」. The body says the walled state is unit-pinned only, because showcase boots single posture. Please read it on a console: either a boot under the group posture with a non-operator admin, or a response stand-in for the posture facts the gate reads (say which one). Read three things: the switch is drawn disabled with the reason, a click sends no `POST`, and the operator under the same posture gets a live switch.

**M2. Four changed files are outside the claim surface.** That surface is claim 6943333260 plus amendment 6943362097.
- `packages/objectql/src/action-activation.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/engine-actions.ts`. These are published source. The claim names only `action-activation.test.ts`. Ruling 6944409840 brings into scope the sentence in `packages/types/**`, not objectql source.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`. The claim names `automation.json` and `api-backend.json`.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-packages-door.test.ts`. The amendment names only the platform-objects translations, source-hashes and the tombstone test. The claim names `setup-nav.contributions.ts` and `setup-packaged-actions-nav.test.ts`.

An amendment from the seat naming them closes this. No push is needed.

**M3. The Clause-② line does not name two published widenings.** The claim, the body and the changeset all say `yes (narrowing: … ; widening: new studio-namespace locale keys)`. The diff also widens two published APIs:
- **`@objectstack/types`.** `describeTurnedOffPackagedItem(kind, options?)` gains an optional argument and a new exported `TurnedOffPackagedItemOptions` (re-exported from the package index).
- **`@objectstack/objectql`.** The exported `ActionActivationProjection` gains `disabledPackageOf(name)`, and `describeDisabled(name, platform?)` gains an optional argument.

Both are additive, and their only callers are in this diff. Please restate the line in the claim amendment, the PR body and the changeset, so the seat's L2 at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER reads the whole face.

## Should-fix

**S1. Item 5 and `Fixes #34724` need an order before os-zhuang is asked.**
- Item 5 (the landing's 「已停用 N 项」 reaching a switched-off action) waits for #34747 (#34715), which is not on `main` at this read.
- The approval rule takes an APPROVE "on ANY commit". If this head were approved and landed first, `Fixes` would close the card with item 5 undone.
- The seat should do one of these:
  - ask for os-zhuang's review only after the item 5 push. I read that delta, which should be `BuilderLanding.tsx` plus its pin.
  - or rule item 5 out of this PR, put it on the deviation list, and leave a follow-up card.

## Notes

- **`FlowLedgerSwitch`'s new `label` prop has no caller.** Each action surface draws one switch for the selected item. It is harmless, but it is an unused prop; drop it or use it.
- **Wording.** The Clause-② text says "the public `PackagedActionsPage` export of `@object-ui/app-shell`", while the ADR-0087 note in the same changeset rightly calls the package private. The narrowing that reaches a consumer is `platform-objects` serving one fewer Setup nav item, and the dogfood battery ran for it on the same tree (`f867b47e1a`).
- **The `packagedAutomation.*` console keys are left unread.** This is stated and fine: the eager packs stay byte-identical.
- **`plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 is a shallow-clone prerequisite, and is left to CI.** Please confirm it green there.
- **Routing.** Tier H (ADR path and size). M1–M3 are comment-only, and I re-read this same head once they are posted. Then it goes to the seat (L2 at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, item 5 order) and to os-zhuang's APPROVE.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `86e18a95b4c14aaf23b37da2040b1a7c9cdff72c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md + packages/types/src/packaged-item-turned-off.ts, packages/objectql/src/action-activation.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-actions.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/** (the 11 locale files, their source hashes, the dead-key tombstone test), packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-credentials-ui.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/packagedActionLedger.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/packagedActions.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedActionsPage.tsx and PackagedActionsSection.tsx (removed), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectActionsPanel.tsx, FlowLedgerSwitch.tsx and setupMetadataRedirect.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts, ui/packages/core/src/utils/served-object-label.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts and zh.ts, and every test file of the diff under packages/** and ui/** (read as the pins of the above). Declared narrowing: the whole diff outside the prose faces is in scope; no path is a remainder. Prose faces (.changeset, content/docs/references/api/*.mdx) and docs/qa/platform-checklist/** are read for ② and ③ only.
Security-touching: yes

Inputs read: card #34724 body and every comment through 6946211234 (claim 6943333260, seat amendment 6943362097, measurement 6943920659, ruling 6944409840, dev report 6946037490, claim amendment 2 6946211234); PR #34799 body, file list (67 files, +1355 −1910) and net diff against `origin/main` 6091b645fd (merge base f6f5b50a05); the check-runs on the head. Cited code read on `origin/main` 6091b645fd.

Gate verdicts at 2026-11-17T11:04Z, read off the check-runs API: 25 completed/success, 9 completed/skipped, 31 in_progress, 0 failed. Green so far: Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Dogfood Regression Gate, every `Lint ·` job (the changeset and ADR-0087 gates run there), Type Check · source gates and · debt ledger. Still running: Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Lint UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core 1–8/8, Test UI 1–16/16, Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · workspace. This record judges the contract; the landing pre-check reads those conclusions when they exist.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@objectstack/spec` — `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.disabledActions`: one `.describe()` sentence changes; `z.array(z.string()).optional()` is untouched. No accept-set change, no export change. Right. The two `content/docs/references/api/*.mdx` hunks are its regeneration.
- `@objectstack/types` — `describeTurnedOffPackagedItem(kind, options?)` gains an optional second parameter and the package exports a new interface `TurnedOffPackagedItemOptions` (`index.ts:150` re-exports the module whole). Additive widening on a published entry; every existing one-argument call returns what it did, except that the `action` sentence now names Studio. Right.
- `@objectstack/objectql` — `ActionActivationProjection` is exported from the root entry (`index.ts:27`). It gains `disabledPackageOf(name)` and `describeDisabled(name, platform = false)`; `disabledNames()` returns the same names. Additive widening. `IObjectQLEngine.describeDisabledAction(name)` keeps its signature. Right.
- `ACTION_DISABLED` refusal — code and status unchanged; the message text changes for every action (Studio instead of Setup) and has a second variant for a platform action. A caller keyed on the code is unaffected. Right.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects` — serves one Setup navigation entry fewer (`nav_packaged_actions`), drops its `group_apps` contribution (the shell group stays in `setup.app.ts:60`; `@objectstack/cloud-connection` still contributes to it, and the nav filter drops an empty group) and removes the entry's label from 11 locale bundles with their source hashes. Narrowing of a served surface, as declared. Right.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` — `private: true` in its `package.json`, so the removed `PackagedActionsPage` export is not a published accept-set. What ships to a deployment is the console built from it: the `automation:packaged-actions` component ref is no longer registered, and the route `component/automation/packaged-actions` redirects ahead of `component/:ns/:name/*`, so a nav entry or bookmark naming the ref lands in Studio instead of on an unresolved component. Right.
- `@object-ui/i18n` — four new `engine.studio.actions.ledger.*` keys in the lazy studio namespace, en and zh. Additive. Right.
- Wire: no route, body or ledger column changes. The read stays `GET /data/sys_metadata_activation?top=1000`; the write stays `POST /actions/_activation/:object/:action` with body `{ enabled }`. Right.

### ② Semver level

- `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct: no key, accepted value or metadata type an author can write is added, removed or changed. `none` takes `patch`, and all eight bumps are `patch`. Right.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing: …)` is read by `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` as value `yes`, arm `narrowing` (the arm word is the first token inside the parenthetical). The committed changeset and the PR body carry the same line. The narrowing is real (① rows 5 and 6), so the arm is right, and the changeset carries its ADR-0087 disposition (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), which holds: nothing stored is rewritten.
- The two published widenings of ① rows 2 and 3 are real and are not named by the line on this head. They change neither the value (`yes` already) nor the level (`patch` under `none`), so the semver verdict stands; the line's account of what widens is incomplete. See S3.
- S2 (should-fix) — the changeset declares the narrowing arm and carries no `**BREAKING**` banner. AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3: a non-protocol breaking change "ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner". On `origin/main` 6091b645fd, 55 changesets declare a narrowing arm and 55 of them carry the banner. The gate passes without it because the arm alone is a breaking signal, but the changeset becomes `CHANGELOG.md`, the text an upgrading reader greps, and this entry would be the one narrowing a search for BREAKING misses. Fix on the prose face: add the banner to the changeset body, with the from/to it already states (Setup › Packaged Actions to the action in Studio; a platform action to the activation door).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation, item 5 deferred (seat amendment 6943362097, claim amendment 2): not graded, as instructed by the seat's order of work. This record covers head 86e18a95 only; the item 5 push touches `ui/**` under a declared narrowing, so that head owes its own delta round.
- Dev deviation, ruling scope added (`types` sentence variant, `objectql` projection keeps the package): inside ruling 6944409840's own "In scope with it" paragraph. Answered, accepted.
- Dev deviation, 3265 changed lines: over the 3,000 line and touching `docs/adr/**`, so Tier H on two counts. The landing is the maintainer's or an authorized approval's; nothing in this record lifts that.
- S3 (should-fix) — the PR body and the committed changeset still carry the first `Clause-②:` line, which names only the locale keys as widening. Claim amendment 2 (6946211234) restates the line with both published widenings and says the PR body and changeset read the same; on this head they do not. Prose-face fix: carry the amended line into both. Not a must-fix: value, arm and level are unchanged by it.
- Dev out-of-scope finding, the unread `packagedAutomation.*` console locale keys: they stay in the eager `locales/**` bundle, which the PR body measures at 60.2 KB against a 60.5 KB ceiling. Accepted for this PR; it deserves a follow-up card rather than `carrier: none`, since the sweep returns budget.
- Dogfood battery: the dev ran it on 6b36d1681b, tree-identical to the pushed head by the dev's account (tree f867b47e1a). The seat's amendment asks for the battery on the exact landing head; the head will move for item 5, so the battery is owed again there.
- `plugin-teardown --self-test` exit 3 on the dev's shallow clone: left to CI; the `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` check-run on this head is success.
- `open_questions`: none in the report.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no relay note is owed.
- SQL push-down: no new id materialisation and no in-app join. The ledger read is the retired page's, moved (`PackagedActionsSection.tsx:178` on main, same `top=1000`, same truncation refusal). N4 below is the one remark.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the spec and the rulings. What leaves is a console surface, by the maintainer's word on the card (「打包动作不是应该在 studio 对应的软件包中自定义吗」). For an app's action the capability is re-homed in the same change (object Actions view, standalone item page), over the unchanged doors. For a platform action the console switch goes for good, by 「同意，立卡」, and ruling 6944409840 (A, 「保持原状并写明恢复方法」) keeps existing rows in force with the door as the recovery. No spec-declared capability is taken from a consumer: `disabledActions`, the ledger read, the write door and its two authority gates (`refuseUngrantedActivationAuthoring`, `refuseUngrantedActivationWrite`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts:188–191`) are byte-unchanged. The narrowing holds.

`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`. The sentence had to change (it named a page that no longer exists) and its first consumer, the metadata read that serves `disabledActions`, is untouched. Holds, with N1.

`docs/adr/0146-…md`, D4 amendment. Add-only (+21 −0). Checked sentence by sentence against the tree:
- "on a read-only app package, each vendor action carries the switch, on the object's Actions view … on the item's page" — `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx` (`disabled` and a non-org route package), `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (`hostReadOnly`, `type === 'action'`). Holds.
- "the flow switch's control, words, pre-judged gate and verbatim refusals" — `FlowLedgerSwitch` reused, `useFlowLedgerWalledReadOnly`, `actionErrorDetail` verbatim. Holds.
- "the read is the `sys_metadata_activation` list … the write `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action` … its gate the same `refuseUngrantedActivationWrite`" — `packagedActionLedger.ts`; `actions.ts:190`. Holds.
- "The platform's own actions carry no switch anywhere in the console" — `isAppPackageListed` offers a switch only for a listed package without the `kernel` flag; `parsePackages` leaves a manifest-scoped `system`/`cloud` package out of the list and flags a flat-scoped one, and an unreadable list answers no switch. Pinned by three cases in `ObjectActionsPanel.ledgerSwitch-34724.test.tsx` and one in the item-page test. Holds on the object view; see N2 for the item page.
- Ruling 6944409840: "A row that already switches a platform action off stays in force: no boot or upgrade step re-enables it … the server door is not changed … Turning one on again is the activation door's `{ enabled: true }`, and the `ACTION_DISABLED` sentence for a platform action names that door rather than Studio."
